s00-02-story-613950.wav.text: But one of them comes first, and every other one hangs on it.

s00-06-talk-082fd8.wav.text: Most people hear that as a rule about other religions.

s00-07-story-100963.wav.text: Or as put God first on your list.

s01-01-story-063fc2.wav.text: To understand it, you have to know who heard it first.

s01-03-story-1094a2.wav.text: A crowd of slaves who had just walked out of Egypt, through the middle of the sea.

s01-04-grave-e86feb.wav.text: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day from the hand of the Egyptians.

s01-07-story-b8fdf9.wav.text: And three months later, God brings them to a mountain in the desert called Sinai.

s02-01-grave-4553cc.wav.text: Now Mount Sinai was wrapped in smoke because the LORD had descended on it in fire.

s02-02-story-f9dc8c.wav.text: The smoke of it went up like the smoke of a kiln, and the whole mountain trembled greatly.

s02-03-story-997fe2.wav.text: The people stand behind a line, trembling.

s02-04-story-a46221.wav.text: And then, out of the fire, God speaks.

s03-02-talk-d44c2e.wav.text: The first words aren't a command at all.

s03-03-grave-3f588b.wav.text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

s03-04-talk-9e35b0.wav.text: Before God tells them what to do, he tells them who he is, and what he has already done.

s03-05-story-5f40bf.wav.text: The rescue comes first. The rules come second.

s03-06-talk-e45bad.wav.text: These aren't instructions for earning God's love.

s03-07-story-17df49.wav.text: They're for people who already have it.

s04-01-grave-ffbc0f.wav.text: And then comes the first command.

s04-02-grave-9a294a.wav.text: You shall have no other gods before me.

s04-03-talk-66e98a.wav.text: For people raised in Egypt, this was radical.

s04-04-story-a8e2c6.wav.text: Egypt had gods for everything. The sun. The river.

s04-06-talk-c557f6.wav.text: You spread your trust around, and hoped one of them came through.

s04-07-story-a726c9.wav.text: But the God who just beat Egypt says: not here.

s04-08-story-822f78.wav.text: Not any more. No dividing your heart. No backup plan.

s05-01-talk-a2665c.wav.text: And look at that little word, before.

s05-02-story-cdb937.wav.text: In Hebrew, it's built on the word for face.

s05-03-grave-2d255f.wav.text: No other gods before my face.

s05-04-talk-83892e.wav.text: It isn't God first, then everything else in order.

s05-05-story-bd48b7.wav.text: It's no one else in the room.

s05-06-story-6774da.wav.text: The first commandment isn't a ranking. It's a relationship.

s06-02-story-ebe81c.wav.text: Moses climbed the mountain and stayed forty days.

s06-03-story-774b4e.wav.text: Down in the camp, the people got tired of waiting.

s06-04-story-2b482f.wav.text: They melted their gold into a calf, and said:

s06-05-grave-07d29d.wav.text: These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!

s06-07-story-62e8ea.wav.text: Aaron called it a feast to the LORD.

s06-08-talk-ac7e36.wav.text: They didn't think they were leaving God.

s06-09-story-196deb.wav.text: They thought they were adding something.

s06-10-story-3abab3.wav.text: Something they could see, and hold.

s06-11-talk-14cf68.wav.text: That's exactly what the first commandment ruled out.

s07-01-talk-99caaf.wav.text: We don't melt down earrings any more.

s07-02-story-3a3a1a.wav.text: But the pull is the same. Money. Approval. Success.

s07-03-story-0cd448.wav.text: A plan B for when God feels slow.

s07-04-story-af32c6.wav.text: Good things, handed a place only God should have.

s07-07-grave-1b72be.wav.text: You become like what you trust.

s08-02-story-453a92.wav.text: He didn't add a new rule.

s08-04-grave-5facc6.wav.text: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.
